title: Tree of Thoughts and LATS: Deliberate Search

questions.question: Why does chain-of-thought struggle on Game of 24?
options: A linear walk cannot backtrack when an early step is wrong, so later steps compound the error
The model cannot multiply or divide integers accurately enough for this puzzle
The prompt given to the model is too short to describe the Game of 24 rules
CoT requires a calculator tool that the paper's GPT-4 setup does not have access to
questions.explanation: Without branching, a wrong early subexpression poisons the rest of the chain; the paper measures only 4 percent for CoT.

questions.question: What is a node in a Tree of Thoughts search?
options: A single token produced by the model during autoregressive decoding
A coherent intermediate step or thought, with K possible child expansions
A weight update applied to the model during a fine-tuning pass
A tool registered with the runtime that the search itself can call at each node
questions.explanation: ToT treats reasoning as a tree where each node is an intermediate thought that can expand into K children.

questions.question: Which of these three is NOT one of LATS's roles for the LLM?
options: A policy that proposes candidate next actions in a ReAct-style manner
A value function that scores how promising a partial trajectory is
An optimizer that updates model weights between rollouts
A self-reflector that writes a reflection on failure to reseed rollouts
questions.explanation: LATS is gradient-free; the three LLM roles are policy, value, and self-reflector. There are no weight updates.

questions.question: Name the four MCTS phases the lesson lists.
options: Sample, Score, Sort, Submit, run per candidate thought
Plan, Execute, Reflect, Stop, the Reflexion-style phases
Search, Synthesize, Synthesize-Again, Stop each round
Select, Expand, Simulate, Backpropagate, repeated every iteration
questions.explanation: MCTS proceeds in select, expand, simulate, backpropagate per iteration.

questions.question: In UCT, what is the role of the exploration constant c?
options: It weights the exploration term sqrt(ln N / n) against the exploitation term Q
It scales the value estimate Q before it gets compared across every sibling node pair
It sets the maximum depth the tree search is allowed to reach during a run
It controls how many rollouts run per iteration of the search loop overall
questions.explanation: c balances exploitation (Q) against the exploration term; tune per task.

questions.question: When is search actively harmful compared to a single trajectory?
options: When the task genuinely has multiple correct answers that the evaluator can accept as right
When the evaluator is noisy and there is a single right answer, so the search converges on a good-scoring wrong answer
Whenever tokens are cheap enough that the extra search budget barely matters for the budget
When the task being solved is code generation with unit tests serving as the value function
questions.explanation: A noisy value function plus a single correct answer is exactly when search overfits to the noise.
